principle: Test laws against measured signals and audited baryonic tracers, never against an inferred invisible component treated as ground truth.
allowed_primary_observables: raw detector counts with calibration and background provenance
angular positions, separations, shapes, and image topology
measured baryonic light and gas tracers with explicit uncertainty

allowed_derived_quantities.rule: Every derived value must retain the raw inputs, transformation, calibration, uncertainty, and assumptions needed to reproduce it.
preferred_distance_free_examples: raw lens-image relative positions and topology

redshift.allowed: Use the measured spectral wavelength ratio z = delta_lambda/lambda_rest with instrument and line-identification provenance.
not_allowed_by_default: using a redshift-derived distance to infer mass or physical size
assuming a cosmological model inside a supposedly raw observational gate
redshift.exception_rule: A redshift-to-distance transformation requires a separately frozen and independently audited distance protocol.

supernovae.rule: Supernova distance moduli, standardization relations, and cosmological fits are not reference truth unless a separate raw-data and calibration audit is explicitly authorized.

prohibited_uses: post-hoc rescue of a failed baryons-only law
unobserved_components.reporting_rule: State the tested hypothesis as GR plus measured baryons only. Do not relabel a baryons-only mismatch as a failure of GR itself.

data_opening_rule: No observational dataset opens until its manifest passes this policy and the relevant theory-side gates are frozen.
